units.unit: Needs to write an essay on whether Hong Kong should tighten rent control on subdivided units
Least sure that tightening rent control helps tenants rather than hurting them
Would need evidence, ideally data, plus a counter-view
D6 models whether rent control hurts supply
D11 gives the tenant side and an alternative to caps
Stock kept growing after the 2021 ordinance, so mild control did not make landlords leave
Hard caps are risky but a small tightening of increase limits is fine
The NGO says security of tenure matters more than caps
Hong Kong should tighten, but only second-generation controls (limits on increases within tenancies) plus longer tenure security, not hard caps
D6 says hard caps shrink stock but increase-limits have small or null effects
Counter-view: rent burden still worsened from 31 to 34 percent even under the ordinance, so maybe the ordinance was too weak
Hard caps could make owners leave, and D6 supports that for first-generation controls
Only wants limits on increases, which D6 says have small or null effects on stock
Will argue mainly for tenure security plus increase limits
D11 says 61 percent would trade rent for three-year security
